import pytest
from isort.api import sort_stream
from io import StringIO
from isort import Config
from pathlib import Path

# Test Cases

def test_sort_stream_basic():
    input_stream = StringIO("""from b import b\nfrom a import a\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    assert sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream) is True
    assert output_stream.getvalue() == """from a import a\nfrom b import b\n"""

def test_sort_stream_no_change():
    input_stream = StringIO("""from a import a\nfrom b import b\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    assert sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream) is False
    assert output_stream.getvalue() == """from a import a\nfrom b import b\n"""

def test_sort_stream_with_error():
    input_stream = StringIO("""print(1+)\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    with pytest.raises(SyntaxError):
        sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream)

def test_sort_stream_with_disregard_skip():
    input_stream = StringIO("""from b import b\nfrom a import a\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    config = Config()
    assert sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, disregard_skip=True, config=config) is True
    assert output_stream.getvalue() == """from a import a\nfrom b import b\n"""

def test_sort_stream_show_diff():
    input_stream = StringIO("""from b import b\nfrom a import a\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    assert sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, show_diff=True) is True
    assert output_stream.getvalue() == """from a import a\nfrom b import b\n"""

def test_sort_stream_invalid_file_path():
    input_stream = StringIO("""from b import b\nfrom a import a\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    with pytest.raises(FileSkipSetting):
        sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, file_path=Path("invalid_path"))

def test_sort_stream_with_atomic():
    input_stream = StringIO("""from c import c\nfrom b import b\nfrom a import a\n""")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    assert sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, config=Config(atomic=True)) is True
    assert output_stream.getvalue() == """from a import a\nfrom b import b\nfrom c import c\n"""
